Chapter 1065: Chapter 13: Chaos Tree (Requesting Monthly Votes)_2

Actually, it’s not completely empty.

At the center of the secret realm, in the area with the most abundant cultivation environment, a few Dao-breaking realm auras lingered.

“It seems like something unusual has occurred.”

Lin Yuan’s expression carried a hint of contemplation, then his figure vanished from his spot.

…

Secret realm center, inside a grand structure.

Four towering figures were sitting cross-legged. These several towering figures all exuded the aura fluctuations of the Dao-breaking realm and were casually conversing at the moment.

“Hahaha, that Stone People Clan, I don’t know what kind of misfortune they ran into, but they managed to offend the Nine Profound Venerable, ending with their entire clan being captured.”

One of the towering figures, who had ram-like horns, said with a laugh.

If not for this situation, the four of them wouldn’t have been able to dominate this secret realm on their own.

The Stone People Clan, though not extremely powerful, still had nearly ten Dao-breaking realm experts, including one at the Dao-breaking peak.

Under normal circumstances, with the Stone People Clan’s methods, guarding this secret realm would have been more than sufficient, and the four of them would have had no chance of breaking in.

“Stone People Clan—why would they dare to offend the Nine Profound Venerable? And even to the extent of forcing him to personally order the entire clan to be relocated?”

Another Dao-breaking realm figure murmur with slight suspicion.

The Nine Profound Venerable was a Chaos Realm Venerable. To an entity of such stature, the so-called Stone People Clan was nothing more than a speck of dust, not even worth a second glance.

“Unclear. I’ve heard it was because one of the Stone People Clan members traveling outside came into some kind of connection with the Nine Profound Venerable.”

The third Dao-breaking realm figure said, though he sounded uncertain, clearly relying on rumors.

An order from a Venerable to personally relocate the entire Stone People Clan had caused significant upheavals in the surrounding regions.

“Whatever the reason, in the end, it worked out conveniently for us four brothers. This secret realm is now ours.”

The fourth Dao-breaking realm figure spoke, viewing this secret realm as a heavenly fortune dropped right into their hands.

The Stone People Clan had been entirely taken away, and the various formations within the secret realm could still be utilized. With just some minor modifications, the four of them could declare themselves the rightful masters here.

At the moment when the four Dao-breaking realm figures continued to chat casually—

Suddenly, they sensed the surrounding scene shift dramatically, as a hazy and ethereal radiance enveloped the entire space-time around them.

The connection to external auras was completely severed, as if they were now inside an entirely sealed-off dimension.

“This is… the Space-Time Domain?” The four Dao-breaking realm figures trembled internally.

The so-called Space-Time Domain was a domain condensed purely from the comprehension of space-time rules.

Ordinarily, only someone whose comprehension of space-time reached the peak of the Seventh Realm could form such a domain.

Within the Space-Time Domain, everything was isolated from the outside world, like a microcosm, and unless one’s space-time rule comprehension approached or surpassed the domain’s master, escaping was nearly impossible.

These four Dao-breaking realm figures only barely reached the Sixth Realm in their understanding of space-time. The instant they realized they were trapped in a Space-Time Domain, their fear left them paralyzed. They dared not make any rash movements.

“We don’t know which senior has graced us with their presence, but if there’s anything you require, please say the word, and the four of us will undoubtedly comply.”

The ram-horned figure hastened to speak, fearing this mysterious expert might decide to exterminate them outright.

Space-Time Seventh Realm peak comprehension? Such a method could only belong to a pinnacle-level Dominator Realm expert. Someone of that caliber, if they had wanted to kill them, could have done so instantly. Why wait until now?

“Speak—what happened to the Stone People Clan?”

Lin Yuan’s voice came from all directions, descending into their ears like an omnipresent force.

“The Stone People Clan…”

The four Dao-breaking realm figures felt another wave of terror seize them.

A strong presence, at least at the pinnacle of the Dominator Realm, asking about the Stone People Clan? Could it be that he had some sort of relationship with the clan?

Though it was true the Stone People Clan had been relocated on the orders of the Nine Profound Venerable, as for this particular secret realm, it was occupied solely through their initiative…

“My lord, the order to take the entire Stone People Clan came directly from the Nine Profound Venerable… It has nothing to do with us…”

The ram-horned figure immediately exclaimed, dreading being caught up in the wrath of this mysterious powerhouse.

“The Nine Profound Venerable?”

Lin Yuan’s expression remained unchanged.

The Nine Profound Venerable was a newly ascended Chaos Realm expert within the last ten Cosmic Eras of the Myriad Manifestations Void Domain.

The Myriad Manifestations Void Domain bordered the Void Domain where Lin Yuan resided, making them very close. Lin Yuan had heard of the major events in the Nine Profound Void Domain from the past few dozen Cosmic Eras, including the emergence of this Nine Profound Venerable.

“Why did the Nine Profound Venerable order the capture of the entire Stone People Clan?”

Lin Yuan directly asked.

In truth, he had already secretly listened in on the four Dao-breaking realm figures’ prior conversations for some time.

“We truly don’t know.”

The ram-horned figure forced himself to reply, “It is rumored that a clan member of the Stone People Clan, who was roaming outside, had a conflict with the Nine Profound Venerable…”

All four Dao-breaking realm figures anxiously shared everything they knew without the least reservation.

Under the envelopment of the Space-Time Domain, none of them dared to lie or withhold anything.

In less than a moment,

Lin Yuan had pieced together the entire sequence of events.

“A member of the Stone People Clan roaming outside offended the Nine Profound Venerable? And then the Nine Profound Venerable ordered the entire clan to be taken away?”

Lin Yuan felt there was something deeply amiss.

With the Nine Profound Venerable’s strength, the trivial Stone People Clan, if they had offended or enraged him, could be annihilated with a mere thought.

As for the effort of capturing the entire clan?

What could possibly justify it?

To Lin Yuan, this action was utterly superfluous, entirely unnecessary.

Unless… there was a deeper motive at play.

Surrounded by hazy, misty space-time.

The four Dao-breaking realm figures felt immense anxiety.

They had spilled everything they knew, and their survival now depended on the will of this mighty expert.

“Cease resisting. I will perform a ‘Soul Search’ on you.”
